caption: Evaluating the Pareto frontiers obtained through COLE after 70 generations (after convergence is reached) and 10 generations against the standard compiler optimization levels (-O1, -O2, -O3 and -Os) and random sampling (with the same exploration time budget as COLE with 10 generations).
